subject: Public product and catalogue observations for the ACS / Apar's Classroom ecosystem

observations: The site presents ACS as a six-brand network.
It describes coverage from Class 6 through university engineering.
Brand positioning includes school, college/admission, books/publications, offline exams and marketplace.
sources.caveat: The 1M+ learner figure is a first-party marketing claim, not independently audited.

observations: Separate HSC 2027 and HSC 2028 academic cycle catalogue sections are publicly visible.
HSC 2028 course families include Physics, Higher Math, Biology, Chemistry, English, Bangla and ICT/EBI.
HSC 2027 course families include Physics, Higher Math, Chemistry, Biology, English and combined Bangla/English/ICT programmes.
The catalogue includes academic courses and admission programmes.
sources.caveat: Course catalogue presence is not proof of lesson quality, completion, live delivery or student outcomes.

observations: The page displayed 103 courses at capture time.
Listings expose cohort, subject/category, cycle count, price and some enrolled-student counts.
Examples of visible HSC 2027 offerings include Physics, Higher Math, Chemistry, Biology, English and Bangla; ICT is separately visible on catalogue pages.
HSC 2028 listings include Physics, Higher Math, Chemistry, Biology, English, Bangla and EBI.
sources.caveat: Counts, prices and enrolments are dynamic snapshots, may be incomplete, and are not independently audited.

observations: HSC 2027 academic cycle page has named subject-specific course offers.
Course pages advertise cycle structures and selected course descriptions.
Some programme descriptions explicitly combine board preparation and admission preparation.
sources.caveat: Marketing claims and course page text require independent validation.

observations: HSC 2028 academic cycle page has Physics, Higher Math, Chemistry, Biology, English, Bangla and ICT/EBI course families.
The page advertises six-cycle structures for some core science subjects.
sources.caveat: Catalogue listing does not prove all cycle materials are released or reviewed.

jmt_strategy.positioning: Use ACS as a benchmark, not a clone target. Build original JMT design, content, code and brand, with measurable quality advantages.
benchmark_dimensions: Interactive virtual labs and coding environments
Accessibility, offline support and low-bandwidth reliability
jmt_strategy.guardrail: Do not convert competitor marketing claims into JMT requirements without evidence. Evaluate the user-supplied observations separately from public catalogue evidence.

limitations: Public course catalogue does not provide reliable access to all course lessons or internal student features.
User-observed ACS app features have not been independently re-observed in this research tranche.
No competitor account was accessed, no private student data was collected, and no paid course was purchased.
This is a public benchmark snapshot, not a complete product teardown.
